findings.title: 握手缺协议元数据默认接受 v1
findings.implementation: 握手必须有 protocol 元数据；TS/Kotlin 校验范围、中央完整响应及 fixtures 联动更新。
findings.risk: 中：新客户端连不上旧中央；强加字段会使旧桌面客户端 strict parse 失败
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: 旧任务状态映射与 execution 双表示
findings.implementation: 移除历史 materialization 脚本、未知/缺状态默认值与 canceled 别名；当前领域阶段到 execution 调度状态的投影继续保留。
findings.risk: 高：直接删会损坏当前任务、错误恢复动作；只删除可选脚本风险低，失去人工补历史 envelope 的入口
findings.originalDecision: 当前链路仍依赖，必须重构后删除

findings.title: 统一 v 标签和无 component 发布清单
findings.implementation: 组件身份与组件发布 tag 必填；删除统一 v 标签、无 component 清单及容器执行版本探测回退。
findings.risk: 中：旧版升级/固定版本下载/版本识别失效；签名、hash、来源与包身份验证仍需保留
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: 旧根目录 env 与 legacy profile 直接启动
findings.implementation: 普通 profile 命名 default，拒绝 legacy；只在显式 MOTE_ENV_FILE 时读取配置文件，不自动读取根 .env。
findings.risk: 中：新配置可能指错数据目录、换掉令牌、看起来仓库为空
findings.originalDecision: 仍是受支持入口，删除会改变产品用法

findings.title: Agent timeoutMs 旧 SDK 参数
findings.implementation: SDK 仅接收 requestTimeoutMs / agentTimeoutMs；删除 timeoutMs alias。两种期限独立，Codex 当前 null 整体期限语义保留。
findings.risk: 中：旧调用失去原超时，可能改成默认导致过早失败或长占用；部分 fixture 刻意传很短旧值
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: DeepSeek 旧官方根地址重写
findings.implementation: 删除用户显式 DeepSeek 根地址重写；未填地址时由当前 provider preset 选择官方入口。
findings.risk: 中：旧地址下请求路径错误、模型调用失败
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: Codex 旧缺速度值补 Standard 与 off 字段映射
findings.implementation: 当前 Codex 预设必须显式有 serviceTier；保留 Codex 当前协议 off/none、fast/priority 参数翻译。
findings.risk: 中：速度选择或推理选项无法显示、协议拒绝请求
findings.originalDecision: 缺值 default 可迁移后删；off/none 仍是当前契约

findings.title: 网页旧会话 url 校验和缺 viewScope 补身份
findings.implementation: 持久 session 必须有合法 viewScope；含旧 url 字段的身份拒绝，期限与跨节点缓存隔离继续保留。
findings.risk: 低中：重新登录/时间筛选丢失；误删服务边界校验有凭据跨节点风险
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: 旧资料页导航转 archive collection 与路由别名
findings.implementation: 删除旧 captures/files/memory/materials 页面与旧路由别名；使用 library 的显式 collection 查询。当前插件 collections 保留。
findings.risk: 低中：旧书签/当前导航落错页，功能页布局改变
findings.originalDecision: 兼容和现行路由共用，先更新调用方

findings.title: 旧网页随手记缺 client 身份与当前 prepared 幂等重试共用
findings.implementation: 笔记 outbox 升为 mote.notes.v3，要求 web client 身份；旧键拒绝并保留原值，已准备提交的固定ID和安全重试保留。
findings.risk: 高：同ID不同payload冲突、重复笔记或离线草稿无法提交
findings.originalDecision: 可退役的是旧 web 身份形状；prepared 原样复用必须保留

findings.title: UUID裸证据引用和注入reader不透明旧ID
findings.implementation: 公开证据引用仅 capture:UUID / memory:UUID（以及固定版本 Material/Artifact）；重构所有生产方、工具桥与UI消费者。声明为 resource ID 的接口与原件 record.id 继续使用 UUID，不推断裸ID命名空间。
findings.risk: 高：证据详情/引用/文件读取失效；错把source ID当证据会破坏授权边界
findings.originalDecision: 当前API仍使用裸ID，必须整体改契约

findings.title: 注入 ContextReader 同时接受数组和分页对象
findings.implementation: ContextReader timeline / sourceItems 只返回显式分页对象，不接受数组；全部注入 reader fixtures 同步。
findings.risk: 中：第三方reader/fixture直接报invalid page；分页完整性假设变更
findings.originalDecision: 需要先迁移或更新调用方

findings.title: 旧洞察 Markdown 读取与现行文字模式共用
findings.implementation: 保留当前产品支持的 Markdown / 文字呈现；后端 epoch3 拒绝旧持久库，无需把现行文字视图当作旧数据读取器删除。
findings.risk: 中：直接删会损坏旧报告、当前纯Markdown洞察与文字模式；重跑旧报告产生不同内容和费用
findings.originalDecision: 历史可读性与现行结果形态共用，不能作为纯旧分支删除

findings.title: 历史费用缺 attribution 与 usage 保守展示
findings.implementation: 测量缺失与未标记 attribution 继续保守显示未知，不能默认零成本或捏造归属；此情况仍可能由当前 provider 正常产生。
findings.risk: 中：统计分组错误或旧回答报错；不能推断未上报token为0
findings.originalDecision: unknown 仍有现行缺测语义，建议保留

findings.title: 旧截图缺 OCR 字段和 charging pending 读取
findings.implementation: 删除 charging OCR pending 类型与旧text/ocrEnabled推断。当前缺测量显示 unknown、activity无图显示 not_applicable。
findings.risk: 中高：历史OCR过滤、向量待处理判断、已保存文字显示或老队列同步损坏
findings.originalDecision: 历史兼容和缺测语义共用，保留unknown

findings.title: 无 stateSeries 的单次采样回退
findings.implementation: 当前单次合法采样不必有 stateSeries；保留单次 duration 测量，完整活动统计继续去重裁剪，缺口不推断活跃。
findings.risk: 中高：旧样本丢时长，跨设备测量统计改变
findings.originalDecision: 现行合法单样本仍依赖，不能直接删

findings.title: 缺 inputPlans 的 Memory 批次进度同时服务当前自动任务
findings.implementation: 当前 Memory 写方固定 inputPlanVersion/contextTime/materialInputs；UI只消费必有 inputPlans/recipeProgress/memoryCount，不再用缺字段旧批次分支。直接原件任务的合法空物料计划仍可显示。
findings.risk: 高：直接删会破坏当前自动/普通记忆任务的进度、重试和取消，清空旧job也不能消除此依赖
findings.originalDecision: 属于现行两条任务路径共用，必须先重构自动任务

findings.title: 模型下载旧固定 .part 临时文件恢复
findings.implementation: 忽略并保留旧固定 .part；所有新下载用 PID+UUID 独占文件，当前实例可续传，仅认领已退出写者的部分文件。
findings.risk: 低：旧已下载片段不会续传、额外模型下载流量/磁盘占用；已验证完整模型不受影响
findings.originalDecision: 可优先移除，先处理旧缓存

findings.title: MCP stdio 支持旧私有 flat connection JSON
findings.implementation: MCP stdio 只接受当前嵌套连接导出；删除 flat 私有 JSON 读取入口，保留只读scope验证。
findings.risk: 低：旧Chatbot stdio配置无法启动，需要转换文件
findings.originalDecision: 可优先移除，需转换私有连接文件

findings.title: 未显式环境名的 legacy profile / 默认 data 目录
findings.implementation: Removed the implicit legacy profile. The current default is profile=default. Startup requires MOTE_ENV_FILE or MOTE_DATA_DIR (either one is sufficient); MOTE_DATA_DIR may be relative and is resolved against the configured base directory, with data as the default under an explicit env file. Status/update paths use the same current profile identity.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current default/named profiles, relative data-directory configuration, environment isolation and loopback default remain. MOTE_PROFILE, MOTE_ENV_FILE and an absolute MOTE_DATA_DIR are not all mandatory.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 模型 timeoutMs / MOTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS 旧别名
findings.implementation: Removed MOTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS, settings timeoutMs normalization and request/agent timeout aliases. Model execution uses only requestTimeoutMs and agentTimeoutMs, including explicit null semantics.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: File-worker and execution-engine timeoutMs are independent current execution limits, not retired model-setting aliases.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 单模型 default 预设兼容多 profile
findings.implementation: Persisted model settings require version 2 with profiles/defaults/defaultModels. Fresh installations save a normal primary profile; deployment profiles have explicit identity. Removed synthesis and loading of a top-level single-model legacy envelope. Selected primary/deployment profile is passed explicitly into runtime preparation.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: The current API view.settings is an intentional projection of the selected chat default and the current update API edits that named profile. Codex serviceTier is explicit default/fast; HTTP has no Codex tier.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 旧 collector 凭据取得 owner 权限
findings.implementation: Owner client credentials and owner-route authentication accept owner only; removed collector-to-owner authority alias. Parent coordinated owner-only native response validation and negative collector cases.

findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 文件旧 flat settings 转 policy 和旧客户端保护
findings.implementation: Removed flat-settings-to-policy migration and old-client protection fallback. New/default/update paths require and persist an explicit canonical policy. Fresh static builtin services/profiles/rules are created before asynchronous plugin initialization, including explicit asr-local audio binding.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Transport limits and settings shown in the editor remain current API projections. Missing/disabled current plugins retain explicit saved policy and block execution until restored; credential redaction and endpoint-change reauthorization remain.

findings.title: 旧文件任务 UI revision → 新执行 fingerprint aliases
findings.implementation: Removed saved UI revision to execution fingerprint aliases and rememberLegacyConfigurations. New steps are pinned to the actual execution configuration fingerprint and evaluate that fingerprint directly.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current fingerprint stale detection, configuration fencing and explicit retry are retained.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 文件/截图旧 running projections 重置为 waiting
findings.implementation: Removed startup resurrection of old running projections with no canonical execution step. Current Memory interrupted work is recovered through the real expired execution lease. Fixed current awaiting_activation projection to remain queued until explicit activation, then retry the same canonical receipt.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Canonical leases, fences, actual restart interruption, pause/pausing projection and portable-backup current running-to-waiting restore semantics remain; these are current recovery behavior.

findings.title: 旧 processing DAG authority/依赖迁移到共享 engine
findings.implementation: Removed processing DAG migration markers, old dependency-table authority replay and constructor migration. Fresh final processing schema uses execution_steps as the sole execution authority.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current processing projections, dependency readiness, processor output/cache identity and explicit current retry remain.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 旧 query/insight receipts 安装 canonical execution
findings.implementation: Removed installation of canonical receipts for legacy query/insight runs. A stored run missing its canonical step is rejected with 409 without rewriting its JSON. New runs enqueue canonical execution immediately.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current owner heartbeat, running-step interruption, deadline/fence protection and genuine crashed-owner recovery remain and use actual execution receipts in fixtures.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 启动时 reviewed legacy Memory 自动发布、清 proposed checkpoints
findings.implementation: Removed activateReviewedLegacy constructor publication and legacy proposed-checkpoint clearing. Startup does not publish or mutate historical Memory; current extraction requires verified admission/proof and publishes through the current transaction.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current bounded exact review, publication receipts, checkpoints and current revision replacement remain.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 旧 Memory 删除意图身份/来源 lineage 补齐
findings.implementation: Removed ALTER/default/identity/lineage backfills. Fresh deletion dependencies include origin identity and lineage keys; deletion records require sourceLineageComplete and derivationSourceIds rather than filling them on read.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current deletion intent, prevent-resurrection checks, ancestor identity and partial-lineage conservative protection remain.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: OCR managed settings 和旧连接失败一次性恢复
findings.implementation: Removed old managed OCR settings migration, startup failed-job reset markers and obsolete connection-failure retry reset. Fresh managed settings are explicit; readiness cannot clear exhausted attempts. Retired charging reason is no longer produced.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Current worker readiness, bounded waits, explicit owner retry, provider failure classification, cancellation/fencing and unknown missing OCR status remain. Fixtures verify no automatic exhausted-failure reset.

findings.title: 不支持的旧 vault/Coding 索引启动拒绝
findings.implementation: Fresh backend schema is epoch 3/user_version 3. An old/missing populated epoch is rejected before schema/data mutation; no automatic upgrade, reset or real-directory read was performed.
findings.retainedCurrentBoundary: Malformed raw Coding vault rejection remains as an explicit security/architecture admission boundary; it does not read/convert retired formats. Generated fixture proves old epoch rows remain unchanged.
findings.verification: Current strict-contract fixtures and focused convergence are green; parent will run the unified full suite after merging origin/main.

findings.title: 旧截图/文件任务没有自动付费处理资格

findings.implementation: Removed historical scans rebuilding screenshot/file/Memory search, browser, dependency and source catalog projections. Fresh final tables/triggers are installed and current writes/deletes maintain them. Blob-count seed is a fresh sentinel, not a historical backfill.

findings.title: Material anchors、可见序号及payload删除触发器升级
findings.implementation: Removed ALTER/backfill for Material anchors/visible ordinals and historical trigger replacement. Final anchor/ordinal columns and payload deletion trigger are created directly. Current capture deletion membership is typed capture only, without bare-ID legacy alias.

findings.title: Source pipeline 存量工作无storage/checkpoint/generation/recipe pins

findings.implementation: Replaced old authorization/draft/storage-ledger column upgrades with final CREATE schemas and current triggers. Removed old missing binding/origin/lineage column skip logic; no constructor old-record conversion remains.
